messages:
maya: Quick Q — where should I look for a per-model p50/p95/p99 TTFT dashboard and tokens/sec (hosted + dedicated)? I want to correlate p95 spikes with tokens/sec drops and KV cache misses. Trying to investigate a customer report.

kyle: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/inference-overview?orgId=1 — panels for TTFT (p50/p95/p99) and tokens/sec are on that dashboard. The panels use PromQL against `redwood_inference_ttft_seconds` and `redwood_tokens_processed_total` (rate over 1m).

kyle: example PromQLs: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, deployment))` and `sum(rate(redwood_tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (model, deployment)`

liz: For KV cache misses you'll want `redwood_kv_cache_miss_total` and the hit ratio panel on the same dashboard. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/def456/cache-metrics?panelId=4

maya: Thanks — any trace link to jump from a spike into a trace/span view?

harper: Jaeger link is https://tracing.redwood.internal/search?service=inference-runtime — click the time range from Grafana panel (there's a small trace icon on the p95 panel). We also surface `trace_id` in the logs so you can jump from Kibana -> Jaeger.

ryan: If you're tuning alerts, FYI we had noisy alerts on p95 last month. Recommended: alert on 5m sustained p95 > 200ms for production, with a filter `severity="customer-facing"` for model groups. For tokens/sec, alert on 20% drop vs 1h rolling baseline.

liz: +1. Here's a quick alert rule (PrometheusAlert) snippet we use in prod: ```
- alert: HighInferenceP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, deployment)) > 0.2
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p95 TTFT > 200ms for {{ $labels.model }}"
```

maya: Perfect — can someone add a dashboard link to the customer ticket and add the p95 alert as well? Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-779

kyle: On it. I'll also drop a lightweight runbook snippet into the ticket: where to check KV hit-rate, tokens/sec trend, and traces.

harper: Pushed a small PR that adds a panel showing token-rate normalized by active connections: https://git.redwood.internal/redwood/observability/pull/321 — will help spot client-side batching issues.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Updated grafana dashboard `inference-overview` (v2.14) — panels reloaded. :white_check_mark:

ryan: One more ask: when you paste Grafana queries into the ticket, include the panelId so SRE can jump directly (panelId is in the URL query param). Also add the `model` and `deployment` tags you're interested in.

maya: Will do. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: This gives me everything to triage INF-779.
